title: AnchorSMP
description: Official AnchorSMP powered by WikiaSMP influenced by famous content creator WikiaColors.
body:
AnchorSMP is a refined modified-vanilla survival server focused on long term progression, balanced gameplay, and a strong player driven world.

It keeps the core Minecraft experience intact while adding subtle enhancements like Simple Voice integration and optimized world generation to make everything feel smoother and more immersive.

The economy is competitive, alliances matter, and every build leaves a mark on the world. Whether you play to expand, trade, explore, or start wars, your actions actually shape the server.

Fresh map. Active development. Built to last. Also known as WikiaSMP.

Join our Discord @ https://discord.gg/YQUJfPApxy
